meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完适配器都要手动跑检查、怕漏掉问题

howto.what: 它用真实 senpi 二进制对 Senpi 适配器与任务引擎跑 QA,证据统一写到 .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/ 的 slug 目录,并产出 README 说明测试内容与隔离情况。
howto.when: 当你改动 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下的任何东西,或想对 Senpi 适配器做 QA、验证任务引擎等时接管。

say.text: 对 Senpi 适配器做一次 live QA,证据写到规范目录。
say.note: 会调起真实 senpi 二进制并隔离 agent 目录。

say.text: 跑一遍 senpi task e2e,验证任务的启动、流式输出和终态。
say.note: 产出捕获的 JSON 与 README 证据。

say.text: 验证一下 team e2e 的注入投递与恰好一次恢复。
say.note: 结果同样落到解析出的证据目录。

howto.what_en: It runs the real senpi binary to QA the Senpi adapter and task engine, writing every artifact plus a README to .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/, with an isolated agent dir and untouched real home.
howto.when_en: Use it whenever anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task changes, or when you want to QA, smoke-test or verify the Senpi adapter or task engine.

say_en.text: Run live QA on the Senpi adapter and write evidence to the canonical dir.
say_en.note: Drives the real senpi binary with an isolated agent dir.

say_en.text: Run senpi task e2e and check start, streaming and terminal states.
say_en.note: Captured JSON and README land in the evidence dir.

say_en.text: Verify team e2e injection delivery and exactly-once recovery.
say_en.note: Output goes to the same resolved evidence dir.
